evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moved directly into logistics probing after quid pro quo.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer at step 2.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep said 'upon checking here for October 11th we can pack and move on the twelfth, we can be able to book your stat as early as 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM' but did not present this as a cost saving or flexibility offer with a dollar figure. Later customer asked about 9th/11th option and rep checked availability but never framed it as cheaper or better value.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep said 'no deposit required, no risk and securing your spot' (rate lock concept) but then immediately asked 'Would you like me to lock that for you?' — the ask came first or was bundled, not cleanly separated with rate lock/no deposit as the lead-in before the plain ask.

top_strength: Rep delivered a complete and thorough logistics probing, gathering all critical details about two complex high-rise locations, floor levels, elevator access, walk distances, packing scope, and item concerns with good follow-up.
coaching_note: Step 2 is the heaviest section on the card — the rep must ask the two-concerns question ('movers showing up on time or damage') before any probing starts, and dig two layers deep on whatever the customer names; this call skipped that entire step and moved straight into the checklist.
